retrievalProfile.description: A centered, soft-focus male portrait with a dark vignetted background and elegant script typography placed in the upper corners.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a man with dark hair and a white open-collared shirt, characterized by a shallow depth of field, warm skin tones, and a heavy dark vignette that isolates the subject against a murky background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with direct eye contact
High contrast between white shirt and dark background
Typography balanced in top left and top right corners
Soft, diffused lighting creating gentle shadows on the face
coreInvariants: Heavy dark vignette framing the head
White open-collared shirt as the primary light-reflecting element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head and shoulders centered, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright white V-neck of the shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the white shirt, then upward to the corner typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deeply shadowed upper corners and sides providing a frame for the face.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the shirt and the background.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Elongated, looping swashes on capital letters
Connected lowercase letters with rounded terminals
Uniform baseline with slight upward tilt
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature exaggerated circular flourishes
Terminals end in soft, rounded bulbs

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script used for both artist name and title to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast 70s script style.
Provides the necessary flourishes and formal cursive structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man with dark hair wearing a white open-collared shirt, centered against a dark, heavily vignetted brown-black background with visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white elegant script text in the top left and top right corners, ensuring the swashes are prominent and the text is legible against the dark background.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft and diffused?
Is the vignette strong enough to darken the corners?
Is the typography a high-contrast white script?
Is the shirt a bright white open-collar style?

mustRedesign: Do not use flat, solid black backgrounds; keep them textured and murky
postGenerationChecks: Check for soft focus on facial features
Ensure typography is placed in the extreme upper corners
Verify the white shirt is the brightest point of the image
Confirm the presence of a dark vignette
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + white open collar + dark vignette + corner-aligned script = 70s Singer-Songwriter Aesthetic
